blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Sewer Inspection
blocks.body: If there's an accessible cleanout and the line is clear, an inspection is straightforward. If the line is blocked, we clear it first. If there's no cleanout, we may go through a toilet or vent, which takes more time. We tell you which situation you're in and quote a flat price.

reviews.name: J. Ham
reviews.text: I had J. Blanton Plumbing come service a potential sewer line back-up and I was super impressed with the entire experience. My technician was Stephen Walen and he was fantastic. He scoped our entire line so we could see where our main line hooks up to off-shoots of our other pipes. He walked through all different short & long-term scenarios so we could make informed decisions.

reviews.name: fixedweasel
reviews.text: I had a camera inspection as well as a Hydrojet cleaning, rod, and flush of my 70' main 6" sewer line... The camera inspection was done by George and Raul. They were prompt, professional, and detailed with the description of the process... we were able to see together where the problems were in the main and at what specific distances. I was given several options for resolution on the spot with price quotes up front.

reviews.name: Jon Ricco
reviews.text: Edgar is a fantastic tech and was extremely professional and fantastic to work with. He was upfront and allowed me to view the issues from the camera before any money changed hands. He had multiple suggestions on how to further prevent issues, but was never pushy on trying to sell additional fixes.

blocks.h2: Sewer Camera Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: Is a sewer scope worth it before buying in Elmhurst?
items.answer: Yes. With so many homes built before 1970, a camera look before closing can turn up a repair worth negotiating.

items.q: Can you inspect without a cleanout?
items.preview: Usually, through a toilet or vent.
items.answer: Usually. We can go in through a toilet or a roof vent, or add a cleanout.

items.preview: About an hour for most homes.
items.answer: About an hour for most homes, including the walkthrough.

items.q: Can you locate the problem from the yard?
items.answer: Yes. Our locator finds the camera's signal from above and marks the spot and depth.

items.q: Should I scope a newer home before buying?
items.preview: Yes, especially on a teardown lot.
items.answer: Yes. A new house can still connect to an older sewer line.

items.q: Can a camera inspection be done in winter?
items.answer: Yes. The work happens inside the pipe, so weather rarely matters.

items.q: How much does a sewer camera inspection cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on access and length. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on access and the length of the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
